abstract: The development of mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of low malignant potential in a mature cystic teratoma is rare. We report a 36-year-old single female presented with abdominal distension and was found to have a huge pelvic/abdominal mass. Ultrasound revealed a huge cystic ovarian mass with no ascites. Laparotomy and left oophorectomy was performed to the mass. Histology revealed mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of low malignant potential in a mature cystic teratoma.
abstract_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた低悪性度粘液性嚢胞腺癌は稀である。36歳の未婚女性が腹部膨満を主訴に来院し、骨盤・腹部に巨大な腫瘤を認めた。超音波検査では腹水はなく、巨大な嚢胞性卵巣腫瘤が認められた。開腹術と左卵巣摘出術が施行された。組織学的検査で、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に低悪性度粘液性嚢胞腺癌が認められた。
